# Accessibility Conformance Report (draft)

**Product:** CityLights (W3C Before and After Demonstration, Before version)  
**Report date:** 2026-11-07  
**Standard:** Revised Section 508, E205.4, WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA  
**Runs:** home 20261104-201006-c7db, news 20261104-203152-e226, tickets 20261104-205001-1599, survey 20261104-212616-13d7  
**Evaluation methods:** axe-core 4.13.0, Pa11y 10.0.0 (HTML_CodeSniffer), ADJ rule checks, Nu HTML Checker, ADJ page comparison, us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 on Amazon Bedrock (FOR/AGAINST evidence), human review in PULSE

**Draft generated by ADJ. Conformance levels are set only by the named human reviewers; AI analysis appears in Remarks, labelled as AI. Where machine-verified scanner or rule violations are undecided, Remarks also give a level proposed by ADJ, which counts only once a human ratifies it.**
